testcase.name: both thresholds are exclusive at the boundary
a dead session is not nudged
a stopped picture on a silent link is a lost connection
the loop is decided by the picture, never by what is drawn over it
a picture that stops while the link keeps talking is not a lost connection
no request while the picture is still arriving
a picture on the current surface ends the loop
the escalation taking over ends the loop
a silent link alone is not enough while frames are arriving
a surface that has never shown a picture is nudged for
recovery still fires on a stopped picture with a live link
the session is live through the handshake window and the whole projection
every state outside a live session stops the watchdog
requests are paced by the keyframe throttle
nothing is asked for before there is a surface to ask about
never having heard from the phone reads as silent, and still needs a frame gap
